Usage: trident [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Trident - AI-assisted code security analysis engine.

  Runs 12 scanner tools (SAST, SCA, secrets), then an AI council of security
  experts reviews every finding. Three guards (class, corpus, reachability)
  automatically correct severity over- and under-escalations.

  First-time setup:
    trident install-tools --verify --warmup
    trident config set llm.backend openai
    trident config set llm.openai_api_key sk-...
    trident model refresh                     (optional - enables corpus guard)

  Run a scan:
    trident scan .                            table output, default gate
    trident scan . --format sarif > out.sarif SARIF for GitHub code scanning
    trident scan . --severity-gate critical   exit 1 only on critical findings
    trident scan . --backend anthropic        use Anthropic instead of Ollama

  Configure:
    trident config show                       all current settings + sources
    trident config set scan.severity_gate high
    trident config list                       all available keys

  Deep-dive help topics (run 'trident help <topic>'):
    setup      first-time install walkthrough
    backends   Ollama / OpenAI / Anthropic setup
    ci         GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, SARIF upload
    config     full config key reference
    output     table / json / sarif format details
    guards     what the three AI guards do

Usage: trident scan [OPTIONS] [WORKSPACE]

  Scan WORKSPACE or import external scanner reports and report findings.

  WORKSPACE can be a local directory path, a git URL (https:// or git@), or a
  .zip archive path. With --input-file, scanner subprocesses are not run.

  Exit codes: 0 = clean, 1 = findings at/above severity gate, 2 = scan error.

  Examples:
    trident scan .
    trident scan --input-file sonar.json
    trident scan --input-file sonar.json --input-file dependency-check.json
    trident scan . --format sarif > results.sarif
    trident scan ./myrepo --backend openai --model gpt-4o
    trident scan ./myrepo --severity-gate critical
    OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... trident scan . --backend openai --format sarif

Options:
  --input-file FILE               Import a SonarQube or Dependency-Check JSON
                                  report instead of running scanners.
                                  Repeatable.
  --input-format [auto|sonarqube|dependency-check]
                                  Format for imported JSON reports.  [default:
                                  auto]
  --source-dir DIRECTORY          Optional source context for imported
                                  findings; scanner tools are not run.
  --scanner-corpus FILE           Replay a frozen scanner corpus through
                                  correlation, model review, triage, and
                                  exporters.
  --discover-novel                With --source-dir, allow source-based novel
                                  discovery in import mode.
  --format [table|sarif|json]     Output format: table (default), sarif, json.
  -f, --output-file PATH          Write output to FILE instead of stdout.
  --triage-output-file PATH       Write the automatic worked triage report to
                                  FILE in the selected format.
  --severity-gate [critical|high|medium|low]
                                  CI exit-1 threshold
                                  (critical/high/medium/low). Overrides
                                  config.
  --fail-on [P0|P1|P2|P3|P4]      CI exit-1 threshold using P-tier notation
                                  (P0-P4). Alternative to --severity-gate.
  --backend [ollama|openai|anthropic]
                                  LLM provider. Overrides config and env.
  --model TEXT                    LLM model name. Overrides config and env.
  --target-name TEXT              Display name for this scan target.
  --max-iterations INTEGER        Override max scan iterations.
  -q, --quiet                     Suppress progress output.
  --no-guards                     Skip all guards (class, corpus,
                                  reachability). Debug use only.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

Trident CLI setup

1. Install the GitHub release wheel: python -m pip install 
path/to/trident-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
2. Install tools: trident install-tools --verify
3. Configure Ollama, OpenAI, or Anthropic with the config commands.
4. Scan a local path: trident scan .

The optional corpus model is built with trident model refresh.
Exit codes are 0 for clean, 1 for findings at the gate, and 2 for scan errors.

LLM backends

Ollama is the local default:
  trident config set llm.backend ollama
  trident config set llm.base_url http://localhost:11434

OpenAI:
  trident config set llm.backend openai
  trident config set llm.openai_api_key sk-...

Anthropic:
  trident config set llm.backend anthropic
  trident config set llm.anthropic_api_key sk-ant-...

Cloud backends receive the code context required for review. Choose one that
matches the sensitivity of the target.

CI integration

Exit codes:
  0 = clean, 1 = confirmed findings at or above the gate, 2 = scan error

Install the package and scanner tools, then write machine-readable output:
  python -m pip install path/to/trident-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
  trident install-tools
  trident scan . --format sarif --output-file trident.sarif --quiet

Upload the SARIF file with the CI provider's code-scanning integration. Use
JSON instead for custom processing:
  trident scan . --format json --output-file trident.json --quiet

Configuration

Show, set, and locate configuration:
  trident config show
  trident config set llm.backend ollama
  trident config path

Resolution order is CLI flag, environment variable, config file, then default.
Important keys include llm.backend, llm.base_url, llm.expert_model,
scan.max_iterations, scan.severity_gate, output.format, and model.data_dir.

Output formats

table � terminal summary, selected by default.
json � retained findings, review evidence, triage metadata, and attack chains.
sarif � SARIF 2.1.0 for code-scanning integrations.

Triage runs automatically after review. A confirmed finding is retained for
remediation work, not automatically proof of exploitability. Save the complete 
worked queue
as a sidecar in the selected format:
  trident scan . --format json --output-file results.json     
--triage-output-file triage.json
The sidecar groups findings by P0-P4 and includes playbooks, SLAs, factors,
rationale, attack-chain context, evidence basis, review provenance, original
imported records, dispositions, and analyst overrides.

Examples:
  trident scan . --format json --output-file findings.json --quiet
  trident scan . --format sarif --output-file results.sarif --quiet

Use quiet mode when stdout or an output stream must contain only the selected
machine-readable format.

Triage adjustment mechanisms

Class guard applies deterministic caps to finding classes that language models
systematically over-rate. Corpus guard calibrates severity against 
vulnerability
data after model refresh. Reachability guard uses static call-graph analysis
and fails open when it cannot determine a path.

Disable these adjustments only for debugging:
  trident scan . --no-guards

AI council

Domain experts review injection, authentication, cryptography, dependencies, 
and
secrets/configuration. The judge re-examines important or disputed findings.
The red team identifies multi-finding attack chains. The council can propose
novel findings that deterministic scanners missed.

Scanner tools

SAST: semgrep, bandit, gosec, checkov
SCA: grype, osv-scanner, trivy, pip-audit, npm-audit, govulncheck
Secrets: gitleaks, trufflehog

Install or inspect them with:
  trident install-tools
  trident install-tools --check
  trident install-tools --verify

npm-audit requires system Node.js/npm. Go tools use system Go or the managed
bootstrap runtime.
